audit.why: Lane difficulty 7.5/10 TRICKY with a 51.5% Aurora win rate over 167 games is coherent: Jayce owns the pre-3 poke war, Aurora owns 3 through first item, Jayce owns two-items-plus.

Spike entries name real spikes: Jayce's gate-empowered Shock Blast from level 1, Aurora's level 3 Q-recast pattern, level 6 Between Worlds rift, and Jayce's two-item poke peak. Cooldown numbers were missing from the full layer and are now added.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast 16/14/12/10/8/6s; Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s; Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never mentions Jayce's Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer stance-swap first attack, which reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. It also mislabels Aurora's ultimate as 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why; the real name is Between Worlds. dontsFull[1] pairs the title 'Get E-knocked' with a description about burning your own cooldown — the two do not match.
audit.why: Riot's Mercury Hammer/Cannon text: 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' That shred is the real tell before his burst, and the stance swap itself is only a 6s cooldown, so it is available in every trade.
audit.corrected: Report and dosFull now carry Shock Blast's real cooldown (12s at rank 3) and the stance-swap resist shred as the step-back cue; the don't is retitled to Thundering Blow with its 16s rank-3 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed 'Your committal tool' and 'Your ultimate' as unnamed placeholders with no numbers.
audit.why: The approved bar requires real cooldown numbers where they make advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Named Shock Blast, Across the Veil and Between Worlds with rank cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers read Skill/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Skill/Jayce/Jayce, which contradicts the packet chart AND the matchup's own whys, which say Jayce wins level 1, level 2 is a wash, Aurora trades back at 3, 4-5 is a coin-flip, and 6 and first item are Aurora's cleanest windows.
audit.why: The packet chart on both sides of the mirror (aurora and jayce packets agree) is Jayce/Skill/Aurora/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Jayce. The prose already told that story; only the chart tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: Flipped as an atomic group in both layers to Jayce/Skill/Aurora/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Jayce, with the four contradicting whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer asserts twice that hammer-stance Thundering Blow knocks Aurora out of Across the Veil mid-leap and cancels it.
audit.why: Nothing in either kit file establishes displacement-vs-dash priority, and champ-data/_kits/jayce.json needsResearch is empty (unknown, not 'no'). I did not verify it and did not rewrite it.

notes: Level chart was wrong in both layers and contradicted the matchup's own whys; fixed as one atomic group to match the packet chart, which is identical on the aurora and jayce packets. All four suspectNames flagged in the packet (The Weirding's, Between Worlds, Spirit Abjuration's, Across the Veil's) are FALSE POSITIVES — they match champ-data/_kits/aurora.json exactly. One real fabricated name did exist: 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why. Aurora kit flag misfires worth knowing champion-wide: her passive Spirit Abjuration is flagged 'anti-heal target' when Riot's text says it heals HER, and her R is flagged hardCC when the description lists only damage and slows — I trusted the descriptions. Her W's invisibility carries no stealth flag at all.
